page_title: LEC 0-1 VER | Lecce v Verona 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match is over and Thomas Henry (Verona) gets a red card for unsporting behaviour.
90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Thomas Henry (Verona) commits a rough foul. Daniele Chiffi stops the game and makes a call.
90+5' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ondrej Duda (Verona).
90+4' Karol Swiderski (Verona) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) gets a yellow card.
90+2' Thomas Henry (Verona) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
90' A player from Lecce commits a rough challenge. Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Great teamplay by Lecce as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
86' The referee signals a substitution. Thomas Henry (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Tomas Suslov.
84' Daniel Silva (Verona) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
81' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to substitute Ylber Ramadani and he is replaced by Alexis Blin (Lecce).
81' Substitution. Remi Oudin is replaced by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
79' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) picks up a yellow card.

77' Juan David Cabal (Verona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniele Chiffi with no other option than to blow for a foul.
76' Here is a change. Suat Serdar is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Daniel Silva (Verona).
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Darko Lazovic will be replaced by Stefan Mitrovic (Verona).
74' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
73' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
70' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Antonino Gallo is replaced by Patrick Dorgu (Lecce).
70' Substitution. Nicola Sansone (Lecce) has come on for Lameck Banda.
67' One of the Lecce players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
66' The resulting corner from Darko Lazovic (Verona) comes to nothing.
65' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for an infringement.
62' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Verona is cautioned for aggressive play.
60' Here comes a substitution. Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) is brought on as a substitute for Pontus Almqvist.
59' A corner kick by Verona is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).
58' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Karol Swiderski (Verona) replaces Tijjani Noslin.
58' Jackson Tchatchoua will be replaced by Fabien Centonze (Verona).
55' Lecce can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
55' Lecce control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
50' It looks like Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) saw red with that tackle. Daniele Chiffi won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
48' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
48' Lecce work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
46' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lecce.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Remi Oudin (Lecce) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
45+2' The corner is swung in but Lecce can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+2' Surely that's handball by one of the Verona players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
45+1' Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Tomas Suslov (Verona).
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

45' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Lorenzo Montipo shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
43' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
42' Tomas Suslov (Verona) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
40' A spell of possession for Lecce in an attempt to control the game.
37' Lameck Banda (Lecce) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
35' Flag up against Valentin Gendrey (Lecce). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
34' Tomas Suslov (Verona) produces a shot from a long-range free kick, but it flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
33' Handball! A player from Lecce handled the ball.

32' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he fails to change the score as his effort deflects away off the bar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
30' The corner by Remi Oudin (Lecce) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
29' Lecce fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air. Good work from Lecce as they win a corner.

29' Remi Oudin (Lecce) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
29' Great touch by Remi Oudin (Lecce) as he received a precise pass on the edge of the box. His powerful shot bounced off the goalkeeper’s gloves and hit the post.
28' Remi Oudin (Lecce) works the corner short.
26' Tomas Suslov (Verona) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
24' None of the Lecce players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
24' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
24' Referee Daniele Chiffi makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
23' Surely that's handball by one of the Verona players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

22' That was close by Michael Folorunsho (Verona)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
19' Remi Oudin (Lecce) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
19' Suat Serdar (Verona) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
17' 0 - 1 Goal! Tomas Suslov plays a short, square pass into the path of Michael Folorunsho (Verona), who bends a shot straight into the bottom left corner to make it 0:1. Fabulous goal!

16' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Daniele Chiffi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
15' Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game. One of the players from Lecce won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.

14' Lameck Banda (Lecce) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Lorenzo Montipo makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the middle of the target.

14' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
13' Tomas Suslov (Verona) will deliver the corner kick.
12' Rough tackle by Antonino Gallo (Lecce). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Darko Lazovic (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wladimiro Falcone, who smothers the ball.
7' The foul by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) was seen by Daniele Chiffi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

5' My Gran could have done better! Darko Lazovic (Verona) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
4' Remi Oudin (Lecce) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.
2' Wladimiro Falcone makes a brilliant save! Tijjani Noslin (Verona) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal.
1' Ondrej Duda (Verona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Verona will kick the game off.
Daniele Chiffi got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
